drafts.text:
Why does a breaker keep tripping? ⚡

Usually one of three things:
Too much on one circuit
A short in the wiring
A ground fault

Resetting it over and over isn't a fix. If it trips again right away, leave it off and call a licensed electrician.
drafts.pattern: Question opener answered with a short list (evergreen safety explainer, electric_4u style)
drafts.video_tip: 5-second close-up of a tripped breaker sitting in the middle position next to ones that are on.
drafts.best_time_ct: No electrician-account timing today (electric_4u / Fat_Electrician / mikeroweworks silent in the window).

Hurricane season runs through November.

If you run a portable generator, never plug it into a dryer outlet to power the house. That's backfeeding. It can shock the lineman working on the street.

Use extension cords, or get a transfer switch or interlock installed.
